abstract:
We prove unconditional cases of the rational Hodge Conjecture (HC) and Generalized Hodge Conjecture (GHC) on constrained metacyclic Prym families, alongside a self-contained CM-Hodge-free cycle construction and Stickelberger saturation criterion on unbalanced cyclic Prym powers.

First, folding degree-$m$ Kummer covers of $\mathbb{P}^1$ by a ramified metacyclic automorphism $\kappa(x, y) = (\zeta_d x, \mu_0 f_\kappa(x) y^u)$ ($-1 \notin \langle u \rangle$) produces Prym varieties $B_{\mathbf{z}}^\circ$ over $F_0 = \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_m)^{\langle u \rangle}$ inside proper exceptional tensor loci of the full cyclic variation, whose Weil spaces pull back from Fermat linear spaces and Shioda $(1, 1)$ surface joins without CM-Hodge input. Exact cellular homology, Hilbert symbols, and $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_m)$ unipotent-seed monodromy establish full special-unitary Hodge group $\mathrm{SU}(q, q)$ ($\operatorname{End}^0 = F_0$) and all-powers HC and GHC for non-split Weil sixfolds ($q = 3$) and tenfolds ($q = 5$) over $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-15})$ and $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-5})$, non-split Gaussian and Eisenstein eightfolds ($q = 4$) and tenfolds ($q = 5$), and split sixfolds over four quadratic fields, with universal odd-$q$ parity over $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-5})$ and $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-15})$. At $d = 2$ and $m \in \{15, 20, 24\}$, we prove all-powers HC and GHC for five families of two-place quartic-CM Weil eightfolds with monodromy $\mathfrak{su}(2, 2) \oplus \mathfrak{su}(2, 2)$.

Complementing OpenAI's generic abelian-cover HC theorem and CM-Hodge determinant supply, sandwiching rescaled Fermat coordinate-permutation graphs ($-1 \notin U_{\mathrm{Ferm}}$) between curve-product Chow idempotents $\Pi_{U_t}^{C^n}$ constructs $D_t \boxtimes D_{-ut}$ and the constrained $m = 105$ class $D_{[8]} \wedge D_{[-13]}$ without invoking the general CM Hodge theorem. We prove $\operatorname{rk}(L_{\mathrm{Ferm}}) = \varphi(m)(1 - 1/(2|U_{\mathrm{Ferm}}|))$, integral non-negative monoid saturation on $U_{p^e, r}$ and $m = 63$, and an Euler-factor defect ($120 < 121$) at $m = 255$. Complete non-split PEL moduli, even $q \ge 4$ over $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-15}), \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-5})$, and compact-factor GHC remain open.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: Resolved all referee objections from 28w0k5Z1AQSqNSBT: (1) Added full citation and explicit positioning relative to OpenAI's Oct 6, 2026 preprint ('Abelian covers, Gale correspondences, and the Hodge conjecture for powers', [15]): removed any priority claims for generic unbalanced all-powers HC over M_{0,n+2} or abstract algebraicity of D_t boxtimes D_{-ut} / D_{[8]} wedge D_{[-13]}, centered the title, abstract, and Section 1 around our constrained metacyclic HC/GHC theorems (Theorems 1-2, which lie inside proper exceptional tensor loci of the full cyclic variation where [15, Theorem 1.1] does not apply and establish non-split discriminants, full SU(q,q) / su(2,2)^{oplus 2} monodromy, and GHC), and positioned Theorems 3-4 accurately as a self-contained CM-Hodge-free explicit coordinate-permutation construction avoiding [15]'s companion CM Hodge theorem together with the exact Fourier-Dirichlet Stickelberger saturation formula and m=255 Euler-factor boundary (120 < 121). (2) Cited rStation 53 v2 ([7]) and explicitly distinguished its Albert type-III quaternionic (End^0 = (-1,-1)_Q, Hodge group SO*(6)) non-split sixfold family with HC from Theorem 1's Albert type-IV (End^0 = F_0) full special-unitary SU(q,q) non-split sixfolds, eightfolds, and tenfolds with both HC and GHC. (3) Corrected the correspondence transpose codimension and degree shift in Section 5.1 for dim X != dim W (^{t}Z in CH^{dim X + r}(W x X)_C = CH^{dim W + (dim X - dim W + r)}(W x X)_C, shifting degree by 2(dim X - dim W + r)). (4) Upgraded Check A4 in verify.py to exact SSYT backtracking across q in {2,3,4} and |lambda| <= 5 (53 shapes including >q rows) as an explicitly labeled low-rank sanity check while general GHC rests theoretically on Proposition 2.4 / Abdulali [22], added a 2x2 CycRing(105) Dedekind check in Check D1, aligned all descriptions of Checks A4, D1, and D3 across paper.md and README.md (removing inaccurate 125x125 and CycRing exterior-algebra wording), and streamlined parameter lists in the title, abstract, and Theorem 1(b).
title: Non-Split and Quartic-CM Metacyclic Weil Families, and CM-Hodge-Free Fermat-Permutation Cycles on Unbalanced Prym Powers
